svg.data-weight-note: 22 lb (9.97 kg per the guide, 21.6 lb or 9.8 kg per the datasheet) with FRUs installed (Table 3)
svg.data-qsfp-plus-speeds: 40 GbE; or four 10 GbE with a breakout cable
svg.data-power-input-ac: 110 to 240 VAC single phase (datasheet); the guide's table gives no value
svg.data-power-input-dc: rated -48 to -60 VDC, operating range -40 to -72 VDC, 10 A maximum (guide Table 17)
svg.data-redundancy-note: two supplies, load-sharing and fully redundant; both should be installed
svg.data-fans: five fan modules, hot-swappable; the switch runs 30 seconds without thermal shutdown while one is replaced
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 40 C (32 to 104 F) normal operation
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-humidity: 5 to 90 percent noncondensing; 5 to 93 percent short term
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation to 2000 m (6562 ft)
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 10 switches in a ring; also a Virtual Chassis Fabric spine or leaf and a QFabric node or interconnect
svg.data-optics-qsfp: 40 GbE QSFP+, QSFP+ direct attach and active optical cable, breakout cables to SFP+
svg.data-expansion: two bays, QFX-EM-4Q (4 x 40 GbE QSFP+) and EX4600-EM-8F (8 x 10 GbE SFP+), 32 QSFP+ ports at most
svg.data-oob: management port C0 (RJ-45, em0) and C1 (SFP, em1) with link and status lamps
svg.data-usb: one USB port for image updates
